commits.subject: Add a token bucket for API rate limits
Keep each caller's bucket in a Durable Object
Limit /api to 10 requests per second per token

notes: Layered and additive: pure token bucket, a fetch-handler RateLimiter Durable Object per caller (in-memory bucket), rateLimit() middleware keyed by SHA-256 of the bearer token (else IP), 429 {error:'rate_limited', retryAfter:1} with Retry-After: 1, fail-open without the binding or on limiter errors, and cache(60) = Cache-Control: max-age=60 on 200s from /levels only. wrangler.jsonc: RATE_LIMITER binding plus a v1 migration (new_sqlite_classes); wrangler 4.149 --dry-run bundles it. No existing test changed; 25/25; pnpm build passes; no new dependencies.
